preconditions.description: The number of problems n is between 1 and 10^5, and the number of teams k is between 1 and 4.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) == n + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == k for line in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n lines of problem data following the first line, each containing exactly k integers.

preconditions.expression: all(x in ('0', '1') for line in lines[1:] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each entry in the problem data is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' (case-insensitive) if there exists a non-empty subset of problems such that every team knows at most half of the selected problems; otherwise output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: exists_valid_subset == any(all(sum(problems[i][j] for i in subset) <= len(subset) / 2 for j in range(k)) for subset in [s for s in [tuple(sorted(x)) for x in __import__('itertools').combinations(range(n), r) for r in range(1, n+1)]])
postconditions.description: A valid subset exists if and only if there is a non-empty set of problem indices where, for every team, the count of known problems in that subset is at most half the subset size.
